title: Hear the narration before it ships
chose: Transcribe the narration with faster-whisper and compare it word by word with the script

over.name: Trust the text-to-speech output
over.why: The director cannot listen, so a wrong name or a swallowed word would ship unnoticed.

over.name: A human listening pass
over.why: It would put a person in the loop for every film.

because: The model has no ears, so the words it hears back are the only proof that the voice track says what the script says.
tradeoff: Whisper does not know invented names, so it needs a second pass and still misses some words.
